card.line: Tel-abib was a place by the River Kebar where Jewish exiles lived, and where Ezekiel sat among them before God made him a watchman.

moments.title: Ezekiel sits with the exiles
moments.text: The Spirit took Ezekiel away, and he came in bitterness and anger to the exiles at Tel-abib. He sat among them for seven days, overwhelmed.

moments.title: God makes Ezekiel a watchman
moments.text: After seven days, the word of the LORD came to Ezekiel. God made him a watchman for Israel and told him to give them warnings from Him.
